name: Monitoring dashboard tracking and local startup
status_reason: Source review of server.js, dashboard.html and both shell scripts in monitoring/. No local run of the dashboard or the anomaly script was performed; runtime behavior claims follow from the code paths read.; verified against sources 2026-09-14 (author pass)
description: Express server (default port 5555) serving a static HTML dashboard that polls Docker containers, host memory/load, CFN loop Redis keys, SQLite agent rows and swarm:* signals every 10s; started from monitoring/ via start-dashboard.sh, while a companion script flags >20% Prometheus cost spikes.
purpose: Start it with `bash monitoring/start-dashboard.sh` run FROM the monitoring/ directory (it exits 1 elsewhere): the script verifies Node >= 16, runs npm install when node_modules is missing, warns without failing when Docker is down or Redis at localhost:6379 is unreachable, then runs npm start (pass --dev for nodemon auto-reload). The Express server (PORT env or 5555) serves dashboard.html at / and JSON under /api/*. The dashboard tracks: CFN-related Docker containers (names matching cfn/redis/cadvisor/consensus/agent-comm; total/running/failed counts plus per-container cpu/memory/network via /api/containers/:name/stats), host memory and load read from /proc/meminfo and /proc/loadavg, CFN loop task status (active/completed/failed, avg confidence) parsed from Redis keys cfn_loop:*:context:, agent health (a ps-aux count of 'claude-flow-novice agent' processes), agent rows from the SQLite DB at ../claude-assets/skills/cfn-redis-coordination/data/cfn-loop.db (SELECT * FROM agents ORDER BY spawned_at DESC), and Redis swarm:* signals. The page calls refreshData() on load and every 10 s (setInterval(refreshData, 10000)). Failure path: if Redis is down /api/cfn returns all-zero defaults and the SQLite/Redis cards show 0 and 'Disconnected', but the container/system/cfn cards silently fall back to hardcoded demo mock data ('Simulate API calls with mock data for demo'), so on-screen numbers may not be live; a thrown refresh error is logged to the Recent Logs panel and raises the alert bar. cost-anomaly-detection.sh is a standalone companion (not wired into the server): per team it compares the last-1h rate of Prometheus metric zai_api_cost_usd against the same window offset 24h back and POSTs a webhook alert plus pushgateway gauge when the ratio exceeds ANOMALY_THRESHOLD (default 1.20); modes are detect (default), health (Prometheus reachability + metric count) and test (10% threshold).

sources.claim: Startup contract: must be run from the monitoring/ directory (checks package.json and server.js exist, exits 1 otherwise); verifies Node >= 16 via sort -V; npm-installs when node_modules is absent; only WARNS (no exit) when docker info fails or redis-cli ping to localhost:6379 fails, noting 'CFN metrics will show default values'; finally runs npm run dev under --dev (nodemon) else npm start.

Express app on PORT env or 5555; Redis client hardcoded to redis://localhost:6379; opens SQLite DB at ../claude-assets/skills/cfn-redis-coordination/data/cfn-loop.db via initializeSQLite() at startup (non-fatal on error, logged via .catch(console.error)).

GET /api/containers lists all Docker containers and filters to CFN-related names (cfn, redis, cadvisor, consensus, agent-comm), returning total/running/failed plus per-container name/status/memory/image/ports; list-level cpu is always 'N/A'; 500 on Docker error. GET /api/containers/:name/stats (line 233) returns real cpu_usage, memory usage/limit and summed network rx/tx from the Docker stats API.
GET /api/system reads /proc/meminfo and /proc/loadavg through a bash spawn helper and returns memoryTotal, memoryUsed and the 1-minute load.

GET /api/cfn scans Redis keys cfn_loop:* and parses *:context:* values into activeTasks/completedTasks/failedTasks and avgConfidence; healthyAgents comes from `ps aux | grep 'claude-flow-novice agent' | wc -l`; memoryAlerts is hardcoded 0 ('Would need telemetry integration'). Failure path: on any Redis error the route returns an all-zero default payload instead of a 500, so the dashboard shows zeros rather than an error when Redis is down.

GET /api/agents queries the SQLite agents table (SELECT * FROM agents ORDER BY spawned_at DESC), 500ing when the DB never initialized; GET /api/redis/signals (line 290) lists swarm:* keys with values, emitting per-key error entries rather than aborting; GET /api/health (line 336) reports status/uptime; GET / (line 345) serves dashboard.html; SIGINT closes Redis and SQLite gracefully.

The page ('CFN Docker Monitoring Dashboard', title at line 6) renders cards for System Overview (total/running/failed containers, system load), Memory Usage (with progress bar), CFN Loop Status (active/completed/failed tasks, avg confidence), Agent Health (healthy/stuck agents, memory alerts, timeout rate), CFN Agents from SQLite (line 325), Redis Swarm Signals (line 341), plus a Container Status list (line 359) and a Recent Logs panel (line 369); a status bar shows system status, last-update time and a manual Refresh button wired to refreshData().
Five fetchers poll the server APIs (/api/containers, /api/system, /api/cfn, /api/agents, /api/redis/signals), each returning null on fetch failure instead of throwing.

refreshData() failure path is asymmetric: container/system/cfn stats fall back to hardcoded demo mock data under the comment 'Simulate API calls with mock data for demo' (fake containers like cfn-orchestrator, 16GB/8.5GB memory), so those cards keep showing plausible-but-fake numbers when the APIs are down; the SQLite and Redis cards instead show 0 and 'Disconnected'.

Init and scheduling: refreshData() runs once at script load, then setInterval(refreshData, 10000) auto-refreshes every 10 seconds; a thrown error inside refreshData logs 'Failed to refresh dashboard data' to the Recent Logs panel (capped at 50 entries) and shows the alert bar via showAlert().

Standalone companion script, independent of the dashboard server: config via env (PROMETHEUS_URL default http://localhost:9090, ALERT_WEBHOOK, ANOMALY_THRESHOLD default 1.20, BASELINE_WINDOW 24h, CHECK_WINDOW 1h, LOG_FILE default /var/log/cfn/cost-anomaly-detection.log); queries Prometheus with curl+jq.

detect_anomalies() iterates teams from label_values(zai_api_cost_usd, team), compares the last-1h rate against the same window offset 24h, and when ratio > threshold calls send_alert() (webhook POST + pushgateway gauges at localhost:9091); teams without baseline data are skipped, not alerted. main() dispatches modes detect (default) / health (Prometheus /-/healthy plus metric count) / test (threshold lowered to 1.10).

unknowns: monitoring/package.json (npm start / npm run dev scripts, dependency versions) is outside the declared scope and was not read; what npm start actually executes is inferred only from start-dashboard.sh calling it.

Whether anything schedules cost-anomaly-detection.sh (cron, CI, compose) or surfaces its alerts anywhere in the dashboard was not traced; no cross-reference between the script and server.js/dashboard.html was evidenced.

Whether the dashboard ever calls the per-container endpoint /api/containers/:name/stats was not observed in the spans read (fetchers at dashboard.html:382-450 cover only the five list endpoints), so real CPU usage may be surfaced by nothing.
Producers of the SQLite agents table and the swarm:* Redis keys (the cfn-redis-coordination skill) were not traced; the dashboard only consumes them.

memoryAlerts is hardcoded 0 in server.js:208 ('Would need telemetry integration') and stuckAgents is always 0 ('simplified' check), so two Agent Health tiles cannot show nonzero values in this revision.
